patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with distinct background colors create clear visual breaks and a sense of depth, often featuring large negative space around key content.
The site uses a highly impactful typographic hierarchy with extremely large, bold sans-serif headings for primary statements, contrasted with smaller, legible body text and subtle uppercase labels.
A sophisticated palette combines deep, rich purplish-black with various shades of light blue and crisp white, creating strong contrast and a modern, premium feel.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background wave pattern scrolls slower than the foreground text, adding depth and visual interest.
Content sections (e.g., client logos, case studies, testimonials, FAQs) are revealed with a gentle slide-up and fade-in animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
The footer is a prominent, full-width dark section featuring a very large, stylized brand name ('Mammut Studios') as a strong closing statement, alongside contact information and social links.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation system (likely GSAP ScrollTrigger, as hinted) that applies a subtle fade-in and upward translation effect as elements enter the viewport.
The hero background employs a parallax scrolling technique, where a subtle, organic wave pattern moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth.

The primary navigation remains sticky at the top of the page, maintaining its appearance (dark text on transparent background) and adapting visually to the changing background colors of the sections it scrolls over.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) create strong visual impact, complemented by smaller, often uppercase, supporting labels and clear, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; elements like buttons and image cards feature a slight corner rounding, avoiding sharp edges but not fully rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy; generous padding and margins are used throughout, particularly in the hero and between major sections, contributing to a clean and premium feel.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its bold and confident use of oversized typography, combined with a sophisticated dark purple-black and light blue color palette. The subtle, organic wave patterns and scroll-triggered reveals add a layer of modern elegance, making it feel premium and highly polished without being overly complex.
